user.title: Connect to PocketSmith
user.description: Enter your PocketSmith developer key. You can find it under PocketSmith → Settings → API.

data_description.developer_key: Your PocketSmith developer API key. Find it in PocketSmith under Settings → API → Developer Keys.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate PocketSmith
reauth_confirm.description: Your PocketSmith developer key was rejected. Enter a new key to restore the connection.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid developer key. Please check and try again.
error.insufficient_permissions: Your developer key doesn't have the required permissions. In PocketSmith, go to Settings → API and ensure your key has read access.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the PocketSmith API. Check your network connection.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs.

data_description.update_interval_hours: How often to fetch data from PocketSmith. Lower values use more API quota.
data_description.enable_backfill: Fetch your full transaction history on first setup to populate long-term statistics graphs. Disable if you have a large history and want to avoid the initial API load.
